Biography

A life,
in chapters.

Early life

Born 23 October 1979 in Madras (now Chennai) to film producer Uppalapati Surya Narayana Raju and Siva Kumari, the youngest of three children. He is the nephew of actor Krishnam Raju. He studied in Chennai and Bhimavaram, then Hyderabad, where he completed a B.Tech.

Entry into cinema

He debuted in Eeswar (2002), followed by Raghavendra (2003). Varsham (2004) became his breakthrough, and Chatrapathi (2005), directed by S. S. Rajamouli, cemented his action-hero image.

Career growth

Billa, Darling, Mr. Perfect and Mirchi built a mainstream following; Mirchi earned him the Nandi Award for Best Actor. The Baahubali duology (2015–2017) then made him widely described as India's first pan-Indian star.

Public persona

Known as Rebel Star and for calling fans and colleagues "Darlings". Interviews and press describe him as shy, grounded and low-key off screen, and he rarely endorses brands.

Eras since Baahubali

Saaho (2019), Radhe Shyam (2022), Adipurush and Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire (2023), Kalki 2898 AD (2024), then Baahubali: The Epic (2025) and The Raja Saab (2026).

A silhouette
in motion.

Embers, smoke, and a figure that never turns around. The still is slowly drifting; turn on reduced motion and it holds.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 22 October 2026

The Prabhas Fan Archive (the “Site”) is an independent, non-commercial fan project run by Nikhil Bonigala (“the Owner”). It is not affiliated with Prabhas, his management, production companies, or film studios. This policy explains what information the Site collects, why it is collected, and what rights you have over it. Questions? Email bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com.

1. What we collect

  • Orders. When you place an order we collect your name, email address, phone number (optional), full shipping address, the items ordered, and the payment method you chose (cash on delivery or card/UPI).
  • Payment details. Card, UPI and netbanking payments are handled entirely by Razorpay. The Site never sees or stores your card number, UPI ID, or bank details — it only receives confirmation that a payment succeeded or failed.
  • Fan photo submissions. If you submit a photo to the wall: your name, email address, caption, and the photo file itself.
  • Birthday wishes. The display name you enter and your message text.
  • Quiz leaderboard. The name you choose and your score.
  • Server logs. Our host records standard technical logs (IP address, page requested, time, browser details) for security and debugging.

2. How we use it

Order details are used only to process, deliver and support your order — including sending a confirmation email with your order reference. Photos, wishes and leaderboard entries are used only to display what you submitted; photos and wishes appear on the public pages only after manual approval by the Owner. Server logs are used for security and troubleshooting. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with advertisers, and there is no behavioural tracking or analytics on this Site.

3. Where it is stored

The Site is hosted on Vercel. Data and uploaded files are stored in Supabase (a PostgreSQL database and file storage) behind row-level security policies, so public visitors can only ever read approved content. Transactional email is delivered through Resend. Payments are processed by Razorpay, a PCI DSS compliant payment provider.

4. Cookies and local storage

The Site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. It uses your browser's local storage only to remember your shopping cart and to rotate quiz questions. That information stays on your device and can be cleared at any time in your browser settings.

5. Third-party services

  • Razorpay — card, UPI and netbanking payments (razorpay.com/privacy).
  • Supabase — database and file storage (supabase.com/privacy).
  • Vercel — hosting and server logs (vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy).
  • Resend — delivery of transactional order emails.
  • Google Fonts — loads the Site's typefaces; your browser contacts Google, which can see your IP address and browser details.

6. Retention

Order records are kept for as long as needed to deliver your order and for basic record-keeping. Submitted photos, wishes and leaderboard entries are kept until you ask us to remove them. Server logs are retained by the host for its standard operational window.

7. Your rights

You can ask what personal data we hold about you, request a correction, or ask for deletion — including a submitted photo, wish, leaderboard entry or order record. Email bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com (ideally from the address you used) and we will respond within 30 days.

8. Children

The Site is not directed at anyone under 18, and the shop is not intended for purchases by minors. We do not knowingly collect children's data; if you believe a child has submitted personal data, email us and it will be deleted.

9. Changes

If the way the Site handles data changes, this policy will be updated and the date at the top revised.

10. Contact

Nikhil Bonigala — owner and operator
Email: bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com

Last updated: 22 October 2026

These Terms apply to your use of the Prabhas Fan Archive (the “Site”), operated by Nikhil Bonigala (“the Owner”, “we”). Contact: bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com. By using the Site or placing an order, you agree to these Terms.

1. About this site

The Site is an independent, non-commercial fan archive. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Prabhas, his management, production companies, or film studios.

2. Content and ownership

Names, film titles, posters, stills and photographs belong to their respective owners and are shown for fan commentary and information. Credits and sources are given where known. If you own something shown here and want it credited or removed, write to bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com and it will be handled promptly.

3. Accuracy

Facts come from public sources and may contain mistakes or become outdated. Nothing here is official. Box-office figures and awards are as reported by the sources named.

4. Acceptable use

Do not copy the Site's design or code to pass off as your own, attempt to disrupt it, or scrape it at a rate that harms it. Orders placed fraudulently (fake details, or repeatedly refusing cash-on-delivery parcels) may be cancelled.

5. The shop

The Merch Archive sells small-run, unofficial fan-made merchandise while stock lasts. All prices are in Indian rupees (₹) and include delivery within India: shipping is ₹79 per order, free on orders of ₹1,999 or more.

6. Orders

An order is an offer to buy. You receive an order reference (for example PA-8F3K2) by email once it is accepted. If an item sells out before dispatch, you will be refunded for it in full.

7. Payment

Three methods are offered: Cash on delivery — you pay the courier in cash when the order arrives (have the exact amount ready where possible). Card / UPI / Netbanking via Razorpay — processed by Razorpay on its secure payment page; UPI payments are confirmed by your bank and can take a few minutes. Card and UPI details are never stored on this Site. UPI (scan & pay) — pay directly to the shop's UPI ID using the QR shown at checkout, with your order reference as the payment note; your order ships once the payment is received and confirmed.

8. Shipping

Orders are typically dispatched within 3–5 business days and delivered within 3–7 business days after dispatch across India, depending on your location. Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees.

9. Cancellation

You may cancel an order before it is dispatched by replying to your order confirmation email. Once dispatched, see Returns below.

10. Returns and refunds

If an item arrives damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, email bonigalanikhil2@gmail.com within 7 days of delivery with your order reference and a photo of the item. We will replace it or refund it in full, including shipping. Refunds for card/UPI orders go back to the original payment method; cash-on-delivery refunds are made by bank transfer or UPI. As merchandise is produced in small runs, change-of-mind returns are not accepted unless required by law.

11. Liability

The Site is provided "as is", without warranties. To the extent the law allows, the Owner is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the Site, and total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it.

12. External links

Links to other sites are for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.

13. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes are subject to the courts of India. Nothing in these Terms limits your statutory consumer rights.
